coordinate_convention: Coordinates are in millimetres. Y is VERTICAL; horizontal plane is X/Z; vertical axis is Y.

free_refit.gauge: minimum-norm least squares shifted so mean(refit_anchor_delay_mm) equals mean(frozen_endpoint_delay_mm)

delay_and_residual.model: bias(tag_position,anchor) = mean_measured_range - true_distance; primary residual = bias - (fitted_tag_delay + frozen_anchor_endpoint_delay)

experiment: Phase 0 for tag positioning empirical injection params

measured_range_dataset.link_convention: Rows are tag BSF66F -> anchor_id 0..7 (A..H) range observations; valid==1 and status O/blank are solver-usable samples.

recon.tag_delay_solver_behavior: The offline C-core wrapper uses a fixed scalar tag delay: per-tag override from --tag-delay-json if supplied, otherwise layout.tag_delay_mm. It does not jointly estimate tag antenna delay inside the frame solve.

tag_truth_source.notes: These rows already carry corrected_Iantenna truth, including ID01/ID05 relabel corrections from official_extra_analysis.

production_72p7_truth_cross_check.note: Raw replay session table is used because it also carries source_tr_all; corrected truth matches the 72.7 production accuracy table.

summary.range_source_field: range_mm, falling back to raw_mm only if range_mm is absent
